name: Centaur Bounty
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Many clans make up the centaur race.  Each has its own leader and agenda, but all the clans have one thing in common.  Cruelty.

If we are to ever find peace, then the centaurs must be removed.  And so I put you on the task to do just that.

While wandering Desolace, hunt centaur and take their ears.  Bring me many, many ears.

Do this in service of the Alliance, adventurer, and we will be one step closer to war's end.
narrative.objectives: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, the ears. Well done.

Your service to the Alliance is unquestioned, adventurer. The blood you spilled in Desolace will, no doubt, save countless lives.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have a report, adventurer?
